What we need from you to finish the VeyyonONE review

Nine short jobs. Each one tells you where to click and what to save. Items 1 to 4 matter most. Tick each box as you go; your ticks are remembered on this device.

Do not send any of these

  • Passwords or API keys
  • The Firebase service account key file (a .json file)
  • The value of anything marked Secret

We only need names, code and screenshots. If a key appears in something you copy, replace it with XXXX before saving.

Must have

These decide who can see and change what data. This is the most important item.

  1. Open console.firebase.google.com and sign in with the Google account that owns the app.
  2. Click the project veyyon-erp.
  3. In the left menu, click Firestore Database. It may be under "Build".
  4. Click the Rules tab at the top.
  5. Click inside the box, select all the text, and copy it.
  6. Paste it into Notepad (or TextEdit on a Mac) and save.

Send us: firestore-rules.txt

One runs the AI assistant, the other sends phone alerts.

  1. Open dash.cloudflare.com and sign in.
  2. In the left menu, click Workers & Pages. Take a screenshot of the list.
  3. Click the one with "ai" in its name, likely veyyon-ai.
  4. Click Edit code. Select all the code, copy it, and save it as a text file.
  5. Go back and click Settings. Find Variables and Secrets and take a screenshot. It shows names only; secret values stay hidden.
  6. Repeat steps 3 to 5 for the one with "push" in its name.

Send us: ai-worker.txt, push-worker.txt, and 3 screenshots

This copies your data to Google Drive every night.

  1. Open script.google.com with the same Google account.
  2. Click the project VeyyonONE Backup.
  3. On the left is a list of files. Click each one, copy all its code, and save each as its own text file.
  4. If you see a line with a key, for example TICK_KEY = '...', replace the part inside the quotes with XXXX.
  5. Click the clock icon on the left (Triggers) and take a screenshot.

Send us: one text file per script file, and 1 screenshot

The AI tool that built the app made a folder on your computer with the original code. What is online is a compressed copy that is hard to check.

  1. On your computer, search for a file named firestore.rules or gen_rules.py.
  2. The folder holding it should contain sub-folders named src, setup and tools. We need that whole top folder.
  3. Before sending, move out any file ending in .json with "service account" or "key" in its name, and any file named .env.
  4. Right-click the folder and choose Compress, or Send to, then Zip.

Send us: the zip file. If you cannot find the folder, tell us which AI tool you used and whether its chat history is still there.

One thing to switch on today

2-step verification on the owner Google account

That one account controls the database, the backups and the app. A second step at sign-in stops someone who learns the password from getting in.

  1. Open myaccount.google.com/security.
  2. Click 2-Step Verification and follow the steps with your phone.
  3. Do the same for your Cloudflare login: profile icon, My Profile, Authentication, Two-Factor Authentication.

How to send everything

Put the text files, the zip and the screenshots into one Google Drive folder, then share that folder with us. Check once more that no key file or password is inside.
